title: Simple plastic bin that is clear to see what you have in it.
text: Simple plastic bin that is clear to see what you have in it.. Simple plastic container with non complicated snap on lid.  Not something I would put food directly into it, but I used it for my deli meat so everything is all in one place, where I keep the original wrapping on.  It gives vertical stacking in the fridge and hence you are not wasting any area of the fridge.  With the clear bin, you can see what you have and that is one thing I have in the fridge, cabinets: no more excess buying and you use what you ave.

SPACE SAVING - Shaped for maximum space efficiency; these stackable, modular canisters can be completely customized to fit any space for optimal countertop and pantry organization

MULTI-FUNCTIONAL STORAGE - Different size containers allow for a variety of storage options. Great to store dry goods and common household staples including flour, sugar, pasta, oats, beans, rice, baking ingredients, coffee, nuts, snacks, pet food and more. Also great for storing craft supplies, toys, office or bathroom products– the possibilities are endless

CLEAR & DURABLE — High quality construction made from premium grade BPA-free materials. Food Safe, fridge & freezer safe. Designed to resist stains and odors and withstand everyday use. Silicone gasket is detachable and dishwasher safe for thorough cleaning. Hand wash other parts
